svg.title: Example with made-up inputs: yearly cost of a buy-12-get-1 card versus a lower shelf price
svg.desc: Example with made-up inputs, not real prices; the reader should plug in their own quotes. Illustrative bars. A 60 dollar bag, twelve paid and one free, costs 720 dollars for 13 bags. A 54 dollar shelf price times 13 is 702 dollars. The lower shelf wins this example by 18 dollars. Not a Pet Valu or PetSmart price. 27 Sep 2026.
svg.text: Example, 13 bags: free-bag card vs a lower price
Example with made-up bag prices ($60 with a free 13th bag vs $54). Plug in yours.
Scale: $800 would be 360 px. Arithmetic on made-up bag prices. Checked 27 Sep 2026.
